messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1303] Where does rmr2_3.0.0 expect YARN Jars to be present?
parts:
rmr2 doesn't know anything about classes. It relies on hadoop streaming working properly (which is a java program and needs access to the necessary libraries -- the piece that is failing in your case).

A test program, adapted from the streaming tutorial, is

```
$HADOOP_CMD  jar $HADOOP_STREAMING/hadoop-streaming.jar \
    -input /path/to/text/file \
    -output /path/to/out/dir \
    -mapper /bin/cat \
    -reducer /bin/wc
```

Set the variables, replace the input and output with real hdfs files, and this should work. If it doesn't, you don't have hadoop correctly installed and you need to refer to the instructions of whatever distribution you have. If it does, it's more likely an rmr2 problem, albeit this is unlikely from the type of error. I hope this helps



Antonio

messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1307] Where does rmr2_3.0.0 expect YARN Jars to be present?
parts:
I google around and I found this:
https://www.linkedin.com/groups/Getting-error-in-Hadoop-streaming-988957.S.173956811

The idea is that there are two streaming jars packed with cdh4 and if you are running yarn you need to use one, otherwise the other. I am not sure what the deal is with 2.0.5, but I am surprised you can't replicate the problem with the cmd line as you did. I would double check that the cmd which hadoop returns the value to which the var HADOOP_CMD is set and that HADOOP_STREAMING is really set to  /usr/lib/hadoop/hadoop-streaming-2.0.5.jar. Anyway there is nothing internally in rmr2 to deal with classes, your two levers are those two variables.
By the way, I don't think we had YARN compatibility at the time of 2.0.5 if my memory is not failing me. You need to switch to mrv1 or hadoop 2.2.0. This is not directly related to the error you are seeing, the errors would be different. What you are experiencing is most likely a mix of mrv2 with a non YARN cluster or viceversa. Even if you got that right, you'd be forced to use mrv1/not YARN unless you upgrade.

Antonio
